android.label: Android A1 Preview
android.notes: External playback capture validation. Not production. Not HRTF Live Transfer. Site is Tencent EdgeOne China; APK is GitHub via JSDMirror (EdgeOne).

windows.notes: Windows is the current desktop workstation with local HRTF and Live Transfer. No public installer package is published in this repository yet.

ios.notes: Unsigned CI IPA is a developer artifact and must be signed before install. iOS Live Transfer is not complete. 7D1 is ScreenCaptureKit capture probe only.
